kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem delete-data-source --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --data-source-id ds-txejfbrh94k5cx58a4qh --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center for Cloud Threat Detection and Response (CTDR) is located. Select the management center region based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located outside China.
cn-shanghai: The actual data storage region
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域。
cn-shanghai：实际数据存储区域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response messages. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.

Note: This parameter is required. If it is not provided, the API returns a parameter validation error: "The specified Lang can not be empty."
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。
注意：此参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回参数校验错误「The specified Lang can not be empty.」
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to the view of another member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The data source ID.

Note: This parameter identifies the target of the delete operation and is required. Only data sources with a DataSourceType of custom can be deleted. Data sources of the preset type cannot be deleted
parameters.help_zh:
数据源ID。
注意：此参数为删除操作的目标标识，实际为必填项。仅支持删除 DataSourceType 为 custom 的数据源；preset 类型数据源不可删除
parameters.name: data_source_id
